english.title: Fly UK-registered aircraft on public transport flight otherwise than in accordance with required terms
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which flew on a public transport flight otherwise than under and in accordance with the terms of

(C)_[a national air operator's certificate granted to the operator of the aircraft under article 101(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2016, certifying that the holder of the certificate was competent to secure that aircraft operated by the holder on such flights were operated safely]_
(D)_[a Part-CAT air operator certificate issued to the operator of the aircraft by the CAA]_
(E)_[an air operator certificate specified in articles 10(1)(a) or 10(1)(b) of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 101(1) and 265(7) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the operator or pilot in command of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom
which flew on a public transport flight otherwise than under and in accordance with the terms of
a national air operator's certificate granted to the operator of the aircraft under article 101(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2016, certifying that the holder of the certificate was competent to secure that aircraft operated by the holder on such flights were operated safely OR
a Part-CAT air operator certificate issued to the operator of the aircraft by the CAA OR
In the case of an A to A public transport flight by an aeroplane,an air operator certificate specified in sub-paragraphs (a) or (b)

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Article 101 was amended on Exit Day to exclude an EU-OPS air operator certificate granted or issued to the operator of the aircraft by the CAA - For offences prior to Exit Day, please see offence document H18440.

other.penalty:
Either Way -

Summary: a fine
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
